title: Barriers and facilitators for cultural participation by people with disabilities in Chile
discussion_signal: The public professional post shares research explicitly about barriers and facilitators to cultural participation for people with disabilities in Chile. It supports the atlas distinction between aggregate participation and unequal ability to convert time, access, and inclusion into participation.
linked_research_question: Which forms of time, socioeconomic position, and accessibility determine who can participate culturally?
limits: The item is outside the six-month target window and is retained as contextual evidence only
Post links to a separate research item rather than providing its full design
No causal effect or population estimate is established
